title: IdP compatibility matrix and SSO docs for Okta / Azure AD / Google Workspace / Ping
creator: Marisol Ortega
description: Deliver IdP-specific compatibility support and operator-facing docs for SAML SSO across Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping. Work includes: 1) detailed matrix of IdP quirks (NameID formats, group assertions, signed vs encrypted assertions, cert rotation behavior, single logout differences), 2) implementation of mapping rules from IdP attributes/groups -> RBAC v2 roles, 3) SCIM provisioning/authorization guidance, 4) audit event taxonomy for SSO & SCIM, 5) operator admin controls (emergency bypass, org-level enforcement, cert lifecycle), and 6) step-by-step setup + troubleshooting guides for each IdP. Acceptance criteria listed below.
implementation_notes: Backend: extend SAML handler to accept configurable NameID formats and multiple attribute mappings per org; add configurable assertion signing/encryption policy per org; implement IdP-specific normalization hooks (Okta groups in 'groups', Azure AD groups in 'roles' or 'groups', Google Workspace 'memberOf' variations, Ping's nested group claim pagination). Add SCIM sync backoff and delta sync logging. Console: new SSO Setup pages for each IdP with sample metadata, certificate upload, test login button, and one-click cert rotate. AuthZ: mapping UI for admins linking IdP group/attribute -> RBAC v2 roles and a preview of effective permissions. Audit: emit sso.* and scim.* events to the audit pipeline. Edge cases: NameID email vs persistent, RelayState length, multiple ACS URLs, SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows. Refer to RFC 7522/QoS docs for signing checks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end SSO login works for test orgs on Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Ping with RBAC v2 mapping applied. 2) Console shows clear certificate status and rotation workflow. 3) SCIM provisioning syncs users and groups for Okta/Azure/Ping (Google SCIM via G Suite available). 4) Audit events for sso.config.updated, sso.login.success/failure, sso.cert.rotated, scim.sync.success/failure are emitted and visible in Console. 5) Admin controls exist: enforce_org_sso, emergency_bypass_token, domain_allowlist. 6) Per-IdP setup docs and troubleshooting matrix published in Confluence and linked from Console setup flow.
test_plan: Unit tests for SAML attribute normalization; integration tests using our local SAML test IdP (samltest.redwood.local) + test tenants for each IdP type; automated e2e harness that validates login, role mapping, and SCIM provisioning; manual QA checklist for: invalid cert rotation, expired metadata, group pagination, encrypted assertions. Add regression tests in CI that run a reduced SAML flow against a lightweight IdP mock. Record video walkthroughs for Docs team.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: IdP behavior divergence (e.g., groups not included in assertion) can cause broken access. Mitigation: detect missing groups and degrade gracefully: allow admin remediation UI, email alerts, and temporary emergency bypass. Risk: SCIM rate limits. Mitigation: exponential backoff and durable work queue. Risk: incorrect role mapping leading to over-privilege. Mitigation: mapping preview, require two admins to confirm mapping for P0 orgs.
documentation_tasks: 1) Create per-IdP quickstart guides (Okta/Azure/Google/Ping) with screenshots and minimum metadata fields. 2) Publish troubleshooting matrix (SAML error codes -> actionable fixes). 3) Add API examples for metadata upload and test login. 4) Provide Terraform snippets for org SSO config. 5) Add audit event reference to security runbook.
next_steps: A) Finish security review sign-off by 2026-03-18. B) Merge feature branch and run canary on staging orgs. C) Publish docs and schedule customer beta invites. D) Monitor audit stream for errors during rollout and be ready to rollback cert rotations if needed.
